# SYZYGY

This workspace is a SYZYGY test suite. Start at `dossier/SYZ-INDEX.md` — the router that points you to the right doc. **Before authoring or editing a scenario, you MUST read `dossier/SYZ-TESTING.md`, `dossier/DOMAIN.yaml`, `dossier/TEST-STRATEGY.md`, and the relevant plugin's `PLUGIN-GUIDE.yaml`.** For commands, formats, and resolver syntax see `dossier/SYZ-MANUAL.md`; for design guidance see `dossier/SYZ-GUIDELINES.md`. **Never invent capability** — if syz lacks an operator, flag, field, or syntax a test needs, stop and state what's missing and why instead of fabricating it (see `dossier/SYZ-NOTICE.md`).
